findings.description: The algorithm does not define the fail-closed outcome when the visible book is empty or has insufficient depth to compute WAP for the full `OrderQty`, so implementations can diverge on whether to reject or partially price the order.

evidence.quote: 2. Compute the Weighted Avg Price (WAP) for `OrderQty`.

findings.proposed_fix: Specify that if cumulative executable depth is zero or less than `OrderQty`, Liquidity Gate must deterministically reject before dispatch.

findings.description: The deterministic staleness pre-check enumerates OPEN and CLOSE/HEDGE only, but the section also requires replace order placement to use the same fallback or fail-closed path under stale or missing L2. The algorithm therefore leaves replace handling non-deterministic.

evidence.quote: reject per the rules above (OPEN → `Rejected(LiquidityGateNoL2)`; CLOSE/HEDGE → §3.1 fallback).

findings.proposed_fix: Amend the staleness pre-check to include replace order placement in the §3.1 fallback and `EmergencyCloseNoPrice` branches.
